mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AuthRequired lets the model invent a successful operation by an unauthenticated caller, which is exactly the case FR_001_AuthRequired forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuthRequiredViolation { some op: Operation, t: Task | op.opAuthenticated = BFalse and op.opOutcome = Success and op.opTarget = t and op.opKind = GetTask }

mutation_targets.rationale: F_AccessControl is the load-bearing matrix-based fact gating every successful operation. Removing it lets Alloy invent a sharee successfully changing shared_with — a cell denied by the permission matrix — which violates LeastPrivilege, FR_010 and ripple-violates the other access assertions across cells.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AccessControlViolation { some op: Operation, u: User, t: Task | op.opKind = PatchShares and op.opOutcome = Success and op.opCaller = u and op.opTarget = t and u in t.sharedWith and u != t.taskOwner and op.opAuthenticated = BTrue }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AppendOnly allows an audit entry to be claimed by two distinct operations, modelling an UPDATE/overwrite on an existing audit row — exactly the append-only violation the assertion catches.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj op1, op2: Operation | some ae: AuditEntry | ae in op1.opAuditEntries and ae in op2.opAuditEntries }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AuditCompleteness lets the model exhibit a successful mutation (e.g., a created task) with no corresponding audit entry — the FR-015/SC-007 invariant the assertion is designed to catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditCompletenessViolation { some op: Operation, t: Task | op.opKind = PostTasks and op.opOutcome = Success and op.opTarget = t and op.opAuthenticated = BTrue and no op.opAuditEntries }

mutation_targets.rationale: F_AuditAttribution forces the audit row's recorded actor_role to equal the actor's actual role (FR-002 / FR-016 / Q2=A semantics). Removing it lets the model record a falsified role on an audit row — the misattribution AttributionCorrectness exists to catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AttributionViolation { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.auditActorRole != ae.auditActor.userRole }

mutation_targets.rationale: F_SharedWithSameTeam enforces FR-012's prohibition on cross-team sharing. Removing it lets Alloy place a task whose sharedWith contains a user in a different team, the precise FR-012 violation.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamShareViolation { some t: Task, u: t.sharedWith | u.userTeam != t.taskTeam }
